BiblicalUsage: A chicken is the little bird under the hen's wings, and Jesus says the same words over Jerusalem in Matthew: how often would I have gathered your children together, even as a hen gathers her chickens under her wings, and you would not. The brood and the birdling are the same longing.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the chicken under the wing is the safest place in the world, and Jerusalem refused it.
